issue_request: FHIR-35952 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested changes to TestScript tst-5 and tst-6 so assert.path or assert.expression could select a subset fixture when paired with minimumId or validateProfileId.
initial_application: FHIR-I approved the issue on 2022-02-07, and commit 2dea2a39f38e90040b839591d0261cb44ee589e0, merged by PR #1681, updated source/testscript/structuredefinition-TestScript.xml to allow the requested combinations. The application commit is included in v5.0.0.
additional_context: Current core removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan source and source/fhir.ini entries in f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 and now links those artifacts to the FHIR Testing IG. Later Applied issue FHIR-50529 replaced the old TestScript assert expressions with singular-assertion and operator/value constraints; its audit commit already exists on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current core checkout has no build-scope TestScript source, and the current external TestScript artifact reflects the later FHIR-50529 semantics rather than the older FHIR-35952 exception expression.
